title: How a P-Trap Maintains a Gas Seal
description: The P-trap is a critical component of under-sink drainage, designed to hold a standing column of water after every use. This liquid barrier prevents toxic sewer gases, foul odors, and pests from escaping the main drain line into living spaces. As wastewater flows from the sink tailpiece, dynamic pressure pushes existing water past the trap dip and into the wall branch. Once the flow stops, gravity retains enough water in the trap curve to seal the pipe completely. Maintaining proper trap depth according to manufacturer guidelines and code ensures safe, odor-free sink operation.

How a P-Trap Maintains a Gas Seal

The P-trap is a critical component of under-sink drainage, designed to hold a standing column of water after every use. This liquid barrier prevents toxic sewer gases, foul odors, and pests from escaping the main drain line into living spaces. As wastewater flows from the sink tailpiece, dynamic pressure pushes existing water past the trap dip and into the wall branch. Once the flow stops, gravity retains enough water in the trap curve to seal the pipe completely. Maintaining proper trap depth according to manufacturer guidelines and code ensures safe, odor-free sink operation.
